name: The Masked Boy
description: A masked child with a knife and wound-giving magic who attacks the Theorist and is thrown through a portal.

timeline.summary: Tam bursts into the sanctum to find the Theorist fighting a masked boy, who wounds him; the Theorist hurls the boy through a portal.
timeline.quote: the Theorist summons a portal—a great round one, rimmed with metal—and hurls the boy into it.
